name: grapes
description: Browser extension for exposing web surveillance and contributing privacy-minimized accountability data

scripts.fix-paths: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const dir=path.join(process.cwd(),'.output','chrome-mv3');if(!fs.existsSync(dir))process.exit(0);for(const file of fs.readdirSync(dir)){if(!file.endsWith('.html'))continue;const target=path.join(dir,file);let content=fs.readFileSync(target,'utf8');content=content.replace(/src=\"\/chunks\//g,'src=\"chunks/').replace(/href=\"\/chunks\//g,'href=\"chunks/').replace(/href=\"\/assets\//g,'href=\"assets/');fs.writeFileSync(target,content);}"
